data.name: Land of Infinite Dreams
data.detailed_description:
Guide Princess Luna through Lunaria, a dreamworld shaped by grief, loss, and loneliness. Harness the power of moonlight to uncover the truth behind her escape and help her find her way home. 

Moonlight Control

Manipulate moonlight to solve puzzles, reveal secrets, and interact with the world.

Moonlight-Powered Combat

Throw Moonballs and use moonlight abilities to defeat creatures born from Luna’s fears.


Moonlight-Powered Puzzles

Control moonlight to solve puzzles and overcome challenges.


Luna's Story

Luna, the young princess of an unknown kingdom, has always lived between two worlds.

Each full moon, she could step into a magical painting and enter Lunaria — a dreamworld of wonder and beauty, untouched by the burdens of reality.

But when Luna turned ten, everything changed.

Her mother passed away. Her father remarried. A baby brother was born, and little by little, Luna began to feel invisible in her own home.

Lonely and heartbroken, she retreated deeper into Lunaria — the only place where she still mattered.

Then, after a bitter argument with her father, a mysterious voice whispered from the moonlight:

“Sleep... and you'll never have to return. You will live forever in Lunaria.”

When Luna awakens, the boundary between dreams and reality has begun to disappear.

Key Features

  • A Story-driven Single-player Adventure
    Step into the role of Princess Luna as she escapes into Lunaria — a dreamworld shaped by grief, loneliness, and imagination. Explore mysterious environments, uncover secrets, and shape Luna’s journey through your choices.

  • Moonlight Control
    Harness the power of moonlight to shift the Moon’s position in the sky, dynamically altering lighting and interacting with the environment.

  • Stylized Dreamlike Visuals
    Explore painterly 3D environments inspired by dreams, fairy tales, and dark fantasy — from peaceful moonlit halls to eerie surreal landscapes.

  • Emotional Storytelling
    Interact with the mysterious inhabitants of Lunaria and influence Luna’s emotional state through your decisions. Certain choices may unlock hidden paths, influence character interactions, or push Luna closer to emotional collapse. 

  • Moonlight-Based Combat
    Fight mysterious dream-creatures born from Luna’s fears using magical moonballs and moonlight abilities.

  • Environmental and Logic-Based Puzzles
    Solve narrative-driven puzzles woven into Lunaria itself. Manipulate light, interact with magical objects, and uncover fragments of Luna’s memories.

  • An Atmospheric Original Soundtrack
    Immerse yourself in an emotional soundtrack that evolves alongside Luna’s journey — shifting between wonder, tension, sorrow, and hope.

data.short_description: Land of Infinite Dreams is a single-player, story-driven action-adventure about Princess Luna, a young girl who escapes into Lunaria — a dreamworld shaped by loss, loneliness, and imagination. She harnesses the power of moonlight to overcome challenges and confront creatures born from her fears.
